comment: PC roles the Bloated assessment is evaluated against. personas: the iG Windows Tuner personas that map to the role by default (the user can pick another role in the Firewall Manager; the choice is stored with the overrides).

roles.name: Gaming PC
roles.hint: Games, launchers, voice chat and streaming. No file sharing or remote administration.
roles.description: A home gaming PC: games and their launchers, voice chat, streaming and casting stay; server roles, remote administration and legacy media sharing are bloat.

roles.name: Power user
roles.hint: Home PC that may share files and use Remote Desktop on the home network.
roles.description: A home PC used for work and play: sharing and Remote Desktop are optional, enterprise server roles are bloat.

roles.name: Sysadmin
roles.hint: Admin workstation that manages other machines and may be managed remotely.
roles.description: An administrator's PC: Remote Desktop, PowerShell remoting and WMI are needed; consumer media sharing and casting are bloat.

roles.name: Office workstation
roles.hint: Office or domain PC: file and printer sharing, discovery and management are expected.
roles.description: A managed office PC: file and printer sharing, network discovery and device management are needed; legacy media sharing is bloat.
